pontos: Establishes the emergency program Desenrola Brasil to renegotiate the debts of individuals in default
Sets rules to make access to credit easier and to mitigate the risks of default and over-indebtedness
Amends the CLT, the Civil Code and Laws 10.522/2002 and 12.087/2009
Repeals a provision of the Electoral Code and Provisional Measure No. 1.176/2023
